description: Free. Resolve a check-record pointer (chk_…) from any Ni Biashara shelf payload or free listing match. Resolution confirms the status flag and that a check record backs it — the citable form of a verified/claimed status. The record's content (source, method, timestamp, result) is the paid item, returned in full by diaspora-business-verify ($0.10) and diaspora-business-search ($0.25) payloads. Citing a flag without resolving its check record is the unverified tier.
name: resolve_check_record
title: Check-record resolution (free)
